runTestModule.title: Run Tests
runTestModule.intro: Run comprehensive tests to verify all sidebar options, panels, and API endpoints work correctly.
runTestModule.serverPort8000: Port 8000: Main backend (FastAPI) — should be running
runTestModule.serverPort8888: Port 8888: Test file server — optional, only needed for MCP analyze endpoint testing. Start with:
legendRows: ⚡ Expected Fail — Invalid test ID (expected, validates correctly)
runTestModule.legendNoteBody: "Expected Fail" endpoints use test IDs (like "test-pair-id") that aren't valid MongoDB ObjectIds. These 500/404 errors are normal and confirm the endpoint validates input correctly. To test with real data, create actual documents first and use their IDs.
